Funny thing about premium spikes…

Washington always pretends they show up overnight like nobody in Congress ever saw this cliff coming.

But the public deserves the rest of the story about how both parties helped build the explosion they’re pointing at today.

Here’s what never gets mentioned:

• In 2021–2024, Congress extended ACA subsidies on temporary timelines even after CBO warned that families would face 200–300% premium jumps the moment those timelines ended.

• In 2023 and 2024, bipartisan committees drafted permanent fixes and leadership from both parties refused floor time because it meant touching revenue offsets nobody wanted to touch before an election.

• And in 2025, while everyone filmed clips about “protecting families,” Congress passed multiple tax packages without including any long-term pay-for to prevent this exact premium shock.

So yes affordability matters.
But no graphic or finger pointing changes the fact that Congress ignored every warning about this cliff for four straight years.

If Washington truly wanted middle class families protected, the fix would’ve been passed long before December.

And now you know…the rest of the story.
